subject: Partnering to support social impact at SFU
body:
Hi [First Name],

I noticed Vancity's strong commitment to community investment and sustainability. That's why I wanted to reach out about Unify, our digital platform helping newcomers to Canada settle faster. Given your student banking bundles and focus on social justice, I think there's a great alignment here.

Unify provides resources and an AI companion to guide newcomers through financial literacy, housing, and employment. Your support could help scale this impact, whether through funding or in-kind resources like financial education workshops.

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute chat to explore how we might collaborate? I'd love to hear your thoughts.

Best,
[Your Name], Enactus SFU

subject: Partnering with Vancity to empower student-led innovation
body: Hi [First Name], I’m Michael from Enactus SFU, a student-led social entrepreneurship club at Simon Fraser University. Given Vancity’s commitment to community investment and sustainability, I wanted to connect about potential collaboration with our projects. For example, Unify, our digital platform, helps newcomers settle faster in Canada by providing essential resources and mentorship. This aligns closely with Vancity’s focus on supporting communities and newcomers through initiatives like your student banking bundles. We’d love to explore how Vancity could support Unify or other projects like Alara (cleantech) and Nourish (food waste reduction) through sponsorship or in-kind contributions. Would you be open to a 15-minute chat to discuss further? Looking forward to hearing from you. Best, [Your Name], Enactus SFU

subject: SFU Alumni Supporting SFU Students
body: Hi Hassan and Vivek, I came across Intuitive AI and was excited to see SFU alumni reshaping waste management through AI. At Enactus SFU, we have two projects tackling sustainability and waste reduction that align with your mission. Alara creates biodegradable bioplastics from Earth's waters, while Second Savour upcycles discarded citrus peels into candied treats. Both are Burnaby-based, SFU-founded initiatives making a real impact. I'd love to explore how Intuitive AI could support these student-led ventures, whether through mentorship, resources, or sponsorship. Could we hop on a quick 15 minute call next week to discuss? Looking forward to connecting. [Your Name], Enactus SFU

subject: Partnering to Drive Sustainability with Alara
body:
Hi [First Name],

I noticed Omega Environmental Drilling’s support for SFU Rugby and your focus on environmental services. I’d love to explore how we could partner to drive sustainability through Alara, our student-led project developing 100% biodegradable bioplastics from Earth’s waters. Given your work in environmental drilling, this feels like a natural alignment.

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute chat to discuss potential sponsorship or in-kind support? I’d love to share how Alara could complement Omega’s sustainability goals.

Looking forward to your thoughts.

[Your Name], Enactus SFU

subject: Supporting SFU Students Tackle Real-World Challenges
body: Hi Don, I hope this email finds you well. I’m Adrian from Enactus SFU, a student-led social entrepreneurship club at Simon Fraser University. Given your tech expertise and strong ties to SFU, I wanted to share how your support could make a meaningful impact on our initiatives. Our project Unify, a digital platform with an AI companion, is helping newcomers settle faster in Canada. It’s a tech-driven solution addressing a pressing local challenge. Your sponsorship could help us scale this project and empower more individuals in our community. Would you be open to a 15-minute chat to discuss how we can collaborate? Looking forward to hearing from you. Best, [Your Name], Enactus SFU
